title: ElixirConf 2018 - Keynote - Chris McCord
summary: Chris McCord's ElixirConf 2018 keynote introduces Phoenix LiveView, which renders HTML on the server and updates the page over websockets. It includes a demo showing that latency is not the bottleneck one might expect.
why: HN recommends it as the original LiveView announcement and demo, a compelling argument for server-side rendering as an alternative to JavaScript front ends.

quote.text: you can't ignore it, the coolest thing happening right now about server-side rendering
